message.content: {"verdict":"conflict","citations":["para 19"],"evidence":[{"doc_id":"para 19","quote":"Failure on the part of the card-issuers to complete the process of closure within seven working days shall result in a penalty of ₹500 per calendar day of delay payable to the cardholder, till the closure of the account provided there is no outstanding in the account."}],"confidence":0.95,"rationale":"Clause specifies penalty per working day, whereas RBI requires penalty per calendar day."}
